title: RuntimeArtifactRegistryV1
description: Machine-readable registry of file-precise runtime artifacts a tool writes during its own operation and that must be gitignored so they never make a working tree read as dirty. Generic ecosystem ignores (node_modules, *.log, .env*, OS artifacts) are out of scope -- this registry covers only the class of tool-written, incident-prone transient state described in issue #131.

pattern.description: Exact .gitignore pattern line this entry documents.

owner.description: Repository (or tool) responsible for writing and retiring this path.

reason.description: Why this path is written and why it is transient rather than durable.

incident.description: Reference to the incident this registration traces back to, or null if none.
